question.text: Offences under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) 2023, which replaced the Indian Penal Code, are covered under which part of the PMLA Schedule?

answer.text: They are not yet included in the PMLA Schedule

explanation.text: The Logic: Offences under both the Indian Penal Code (45 of 1860) and the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) 2023 (45 of 2023) are covered under Part A, Paragraph 1 of the PMLA Schedule. The Schedule lists BNS section references alongside the original IPC sections. The Trap: Option D might seem plausible since BNS is relatively new, but the PMLA Schedule includes BNS references. The workbook explicitly shows both IPC and BNS section numbers side by side. Note: Key offences like murder, kidnapping, extortion, robbery, dacoity, cheating, forgery, and counterfeiting remain scheduled offences under Part A, Paragraph 1; only the section numbers have changed between IPC and BNS.
